name: archive-or-delete
title: Archive or Delete
description: Shows Archive and Delete together with each affected thing's fate under both. The reversible choice starts selected and focused so Enter archives; choosing Delete highlights what is lost and relabels the button "Delete forever".

meta.summary: Puts Archive and Delete side by side with what happens to each thing under both, so people don't delete what they only meant to put away.
meta.server: Authorise the delete on the server and, where possible, keep a recovery window; the dialog does not make deletion reversible.
catches: Choosing permanent deletion when archiving would do
Hidden differences between the two choices, by listing only the items whose fate differs first
Ambiguous confirm buttons, by naming the choice and the thing ("Delete forever")
limits: Only describes the fates you pass in; it does not know what your backend really deletes
It does not archive or delete anything; onConfirm does
a11y: Choices are a role="radiogroup" labelled by the title, each option described by its summary
Archive is focused on open (autoFocus, default true)
The confirm button sets aria-busy while pending
The Delete highlight animation is skipped with prefers-reduced-motion; fates are written in text, not just colour
